title: OrganizerInsightsDocument
description: One organiser's public-page activity for one UTC day, rolled up nightly by rollupOrganizerInsightsDaily from the host analytics marts (page visits, owner link clicks by link and traffic source, booking clicks) and organizerFollows (new followers). Server-only; the website owner view reads 30 of these through getOrganizerOwnerView. Document id: {organizerId}_{yyyymmdd}. A day with no document had no recorded activity.

date.description: The UTC day the counts cover, as YYYY-MM-DD (the marts' event_date).

visits.description: Organiser page views (listingView), deduplicated per visitor session per day by the mart.

linkClicks.description: Clicks on the organiser's own links (linkClick).

bookingClicks.description: Clicks through to book an event (the mart's outbound booking clicks). Zero when the mart has not reported them.

newFollowers.description: Follow edges whose followedAt falls on this day.

sources.description: Where the people who clicked a link came from, from the contract's fixed traffic-source list; no raw referrer is stored.

links.description: Clicks per owner link id that day.
